credit_reservations_lifecycle_timestamps.name: credit_reservations_lifecycle_timestamps_valid
credit_reservations_lifecycle_timestamps.value:
(
        ("status" = 'reserved'
          AND "released_at" IS NULL
          AND "consumed_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("status" = 'consumed'
          AND "consumed_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "released_at" IS NULL)
        OR
        ("status" IN ('released', 'expired')
          AND "released_at" IS NOT NULL
          AND "consumed_at" IS NULL)
      )
